title: Missing Pieces
text: Missing Pieces. This was a gift to my darling daughter as a first vanity when she goes out on her own. I was pleasantly surprised that it easily converts to a writing desk (the mirror is removable). The right and left hand side small drawers and caddy all unscrew and can be removed for more uses, such as a small buffet table, foyer table, and even a portable mini gaming table. UNFORTUNATELY, there were missing pieces (!!), confusing and misprinted directions, and tools that came with the vanity are not even the correct size (for instance, some of the screws that came with the drawer knob pulls were too short, so we had to use what we had in our junk drawer). Currently we are not using the light up mirror portion of the vanity because of the issues mentioned above. It's a shame because it is a very pretty set when put together as shown by the seller.

product_metadata.title: MUPATER Makeup Desk Vanity Set with Mirror Light and Bench Stool for Girls and Women, Dressing Table with 5 Drawers and 10 LED Bulbs, White
features: 【360° ROTATING MIRROR WITH 10 LED BULB LIGHT!】You'd definitely love this makeup vanity set for its traditional and practical design with a 360° rotating mirror and lights! This dressing table has one big mirror to allow you to appreciate yourself easily. The light from LED bulbs makes your face more beautiful like a superstar, and can more clearly and realistically reflect your appearance on a rainy day or at night.

【HIGH-GRADE AND NON-TOXIC MATERIAL】This vanity set is made of high-quality solid wood and non-toxic P2 MDF, which is super sturdy, solid and strong for long-time daily use. It has elegant looking by the painting on the surface, and anti-slippery part fixed in the leg bottom to avoid scratch your floor. The vanity stool has internal padding, the sponge has a good touch, makes you feel comfortable even sitting for a long time.

【EASY ASSEMBLY!】Assembling a traditional common vanity set might not be easy, and we definitely recognize it! You'd love this makeup desk for its simplified assembly which is time-saving. Just some simple assembly is required by attaching the legs to the stool and table, as well as assembling the mirror and attaching that. Have this vanity set assembled in a faster manner for your girls!

【SPACIOUS STORAGE AND PRACTICAL】Orderly storing your jewelry, hair accessories, nail polish and cosmetics by the division boards in drawers. The table has three large drawers and two small drawers, which will definitely provide a large storage space for you. More importantly, one of the big drawers has extra compartments that can be partitioned for jewels storage. And you can put some lipsticks and sunglasses in two small drawers on the desktop.

【DIMENSIONS】General table size: 31.4''W x 15.7''D x 29.5''H. Stool size: 14.5''W x 11''D x 17.3''H. Overall maximized height: 53.5''. The size of drawers: 7.5''W x 9.6''D x 2''H / 4.6''W x 9.6''D x 2''H. The weight capacity of tabletop: 132lbs. The weight capacity of stool: 220lbs. The weight capacity of drawers: 3.3/2.2lbs.
